estimand: Within-opportunity full minus selected child-process wall milliseconds, conditional on valid identical material evidence; checkpoint restoration and independent observation are separate costs.
aggregation: Five paired differences per scenario, their arithmetic mean, median and complete min/max range; retain all ordered rows. No confidence interval or general productivity estimate.
normalization: Retain expected order, observationVersion, every result field and screenshot hashes. Exclude only generation metadata/version, record version/signature, and dependency source/artifact location identities from the material signature. Independently validate dependency closure, source identity, runtime and artifact bytes.
decisionRule: indeterminate on any defect, incomplete opportunity, budget stop, contention flag, or multiple measurement sessions; adopt when all five differences are positive in every scenario; retain when all five are nonpositive in every scenario; otherwise combine. Defer remains the reviewed pre-execution disposition.
reviewGate: A parent-created approval binds the frozen bundle and environment, independent fault adjudication and permission to start seed/warmup/measurement.
